reason: Two-time All-Star and 2022-23 Defensive Player of the Year (NBA.com). Traded from Memphis to Utah in February 2026. Tore his right MCL in the Jazz's loss to Memphis on Monday 26 October 2026, out 6-8 weeks, no surgery (AP via Yahoo, Hoops Rumors, theScore; Shams Charania of ESPN reported it). Enough solid sources.

gapNote: Most results mix the new MCL news with an older left-knee sprain (2020) and with a February 2026 left-knee growth surgery, and several stat and contract pages are stale. The page keeps the current injury, the trade and the sourced career facts in one place. Ty Jerome's role in the play is not confirmed by any source read, so it is left out. The 2023 DPOY date conflicts: NBA.com says 2022-23, an AP-based piece says 2023-24; we use NBA.com.
